answer: Proof-of-stake identity blunts Sybil attacks by pricing each fake persona. An agent locks a bond at a unique vertex of the attestation graph before its vote counts; an attacker wanting a thousand fake nodes must post a thousand bonds, so cost grows linearly with forged identities. Slashing burns the bond of any vertex caught signing conflicting attestations, making one detected fraud an unrecoverable loss. Honest operators pool stake in a shared grove of services, earning fees across one bridge of trust. Fake agents remain possible, but each must be paid for, and detection erases the payment.
